svg.title: Music Sorter — desktop preview design
svg.desc: Design mockup for a local music library organizer. Synthetic data only. Folder selection, editable folder layout, reviewable copy preview and selected track panel.
svg.text: Choose where your music goes. Review the preview before copying any files.
Fingerprint similarity is a review hint. This file remains a separate copy.
Exact duplicates are skipped. Tag variants and possible audio matches remain separate.
Review metadata before approving suggested tags.
Compare with the local fingerprint and release details.
Approval applies to the exported copy only.
Five new copies. One exact duplicate will be skipped.
